summary: A bedtime story written around one child's name, age and hometown, with the colouring page drawn into it as vectors that fill cleanly instead of raster art that smudges past the outline. Six themes and a branch on page three - twelve readings. Turkish suffix engine, no photo upload, no download, no API key.
